description:
Current Version:
make sure to delete any old version before adding the new one
Download link to v0.21b

Description
This mod adds a new faction, called the Independent Mining Faction, currently there are 10 ships(4 fighter, 2 frigate, 1 destroyer, 2 cruiser, 1 capital) and 8 weapons.

Ships

Fighter
Rat Class (Fighter/Interceptor Drone)
Weasel Class (Bomber)
Cony Class (Small Drill Fighter)
Mouse Class  (Prospector Drone)

Frigates
Mole Class (Light Carrier)

Destroyers
Ferret Class (Laser-based Destroyer)
Den Class (Carrier Cruiser)

Cruisers
Turtle Class (Freighter Cruiser)
Den Class (Carrier Cruiser)

Battleships/Capitals
Tarantula Class (Orbital Mining Platform)

Weapons

Energy
Archimedes Laser (Mid Range/Damage/Flux  Energy Weapon)
Planet Cracker (Ridiculous flux cost, OP points, damage, and range)
Heavy Glassing Laser (Shorter range and lesser damage than Planet Cracker)
Prospector Laser(Just a small, weak, long ranged laser for the Prospector Drone)

Missile/Bombs
Destabilized Infernium Crates (Basically Bomb Bays, but improvised)
Bomb Launcher(Sort of like a MIRV, but when the MIRV bursts, it fires out a dozen bombs, creating an field of death in front of its target.)

Ballistic
Medium Mining Drill (Exactly what It sounds like)
Small Mining Drill (Figured we might as well tier a major weapon like this, put small on a fighter or something)

To Do List/Feedback
There's a lot left to do, there's still more ships and weapons which are planned and not made yet. Any feedback you can offer on balance is greatly appreciated, and will be promptly dealt with.
The fighters might all, also be too large, and may need to be redone as something smaller as a result, we'll see if that is a problem or not, before getting to solving that.

If you have any suggestions, feedback, or constructive criticism; feel free to post it.

Change Log

Spoiler
Version 0.21b Download v0.21b
- Fixed graphics for most ships(Left out Tarantula, and Fighters, which will be done soon(ish).)
- More work done with balance, if there are still balance concerns, post them, so I know what to fix.
- Added ship systems to ships, that was lazily done, so I'm open to suggestions on what I should really do with them, aside from have them be there.

Version 0.11b Download v0.11b
- Added Mongoose-class ship
- overall re-balancing done to ships
- Fixed Tarantula's price(base price no longer 5, oops)
- Changed Tarantula's variant to no longer carry flaks, the ships is designed to be a very powerful sniper, which dies when things get close
- Edited weapon positions on most ships, they should now line up with the turret graphics more closely, where they were slightly off before
- fixed internal naming convention for ships(Ferret-class is no longer referred to as dragon by the game, etc.)

Version 0.1b - Initial Release Download v0.1b
- 9 Ships(4 fighter, 1 frigate, 1 destroyer, 2 cruiser, 1 capital)
- 8 Weapons(4 energy, 2 missile/bombs, 2 ballistic)
- Campaign integration

Credits
Modders
The Counter - Coding/Sprites
Rybread - Design/Sprites
Forlore - Testing

Resources and Tools Used
Starfarer
Photoshop
Battleship Forever Ship Editor
Kaelis(I think is the one responsible for the ship parts I used in the editor)
